summary: Minimal, legible 3-scene sequence that matches the approved message, timing, format, and tone overall. Main concern: scenes 1 and 3 include decorative star/constellation elements that conflict with the explicitly minimal visual contract, so the video needs small cleanup rather than structural changes.

observations: Title text is centered, large, and immediately readable.
Theme, contrast, and 16:9 composition align with the approved direction.
No logo, watermark, subtitle, or signature are visible.
A constellation/star graphic appears in the upper-right, plus a red underline accent below the title.

issues.observation: Decorative constellation elements make the intro less minimal than specified.
issues.evidence: The approved visual contract says 'Sin elementos decorativos extra', but the frame includes multiple connected star points in the upper-right quadrant.
issues.suggestedChange: Remove the constellation graphic and keep only the centered title on the clean background.

issues.observation: The red underline introduces a secondary decorative emphasis not mentioned in the contract.
issues.evidence: The intro contract specifies only centered title text with no extra decorative elements, yet a short red line appears beneath the title.
issues.suggestedChange: Remove the underline unless it is a required built-in motif across all approved scenes.

observations: The takeaway is short, centered, and easy to read.
Contrast is strong and the phrase fits comfortably on one line.
The composition is restrained and supports a silent video well.
No clipping, watermark, signature, or extra imagery are visible.
Closing phrase is large, centered, and highly legible.
No bullets or CTA are visible, which matches the approved intent.
The scene feels clean and consistent with the overall sober tone.
Small star-like decorative points are visible near the upper corners.

issues.observation: Decorative star points weaken the 'clean, centered, no branding/no extras' closing contract.
issues.evidence: The approved outro contract calls for a clean centered phrase only, but the frame shows small decorative points near the top left and top right.
issues.suggestedChange: Remove the decorative points so the outro contains only the centered closing phrase on the plain background.
